The favicon on tab strips

Each candidate at 16 px and 32 px on the two Vivaldi tab colours from the screenshot and on two light ones. The first row is the shipped favicon.svg: Current ink by default, Abyss where the browser genuinely evaluates a light scheme for favicons. …

Note on the "previous title": its CSS asked for Vuetify's default Roboto at weight 300, but the app never bundled Roboto, so each machine substituted its own sans-serif (and, lacking a Light face, often its Regular weight). The drop-down above lets you see either. The white-outline mark is a preview-only recolour of the dark mark's strokes; the top band keeps its Shallow fill.
